CEO fraud occurs when an attacker impersonates a senior leader and instructs a staff member to make an urgent transfer. Always verify financial instructions from leadership directly and in person, regardless of how convincing the email appears.

Never upload client data, personally identifiable information, or confidential business information into unapproved AI tools. What you type into a public AI platform may be stored and used to train its model. If you would not post it publicly, do not upload it to AI.

Cloud storage links must be access-controlled. A shared link to a document folder can be accessed by anyone who has it. Always set appropriate permissions and never share sensitive documents via a public link.

A clean desk is not just tidiness; it is a security control. Sensitive documents, access cards, and written credentials left on a desk are visible to everyone who passes. Secure them before you leave.

An unescorted visitor can access restricted areas, observe screens, or overhear sensitive conversations within minutes. Always accompany visitors through the office. Ensure they are signed in and badged. Do not leave them unattended, even briefly.

DEEPFAKES are real and they are here. AI can now generate convincing fake videos and voice recordings of real people. If you receive an unusual audio or video message asking for urgent financial or system action, verify it directly with that person before acting.

Oversharing on social media increases your exposure to targeted attacks. Your job title, workplace, travel schedule, and daily routine are valuable information to social engineers. Be thoughtful about what your public profiles reveal.

Myth: Cybersecurity is only an IT issue. Fact: Every employee is part of the organisation's security defence. Cybersecurity decisions happen at every desk, every day. IT sets the controls; you decide whether to honour them.

Silence allows threats to grow unnoticed. Cybercriminals rely on victims staying quiet out of embarrassment or uncertainty. If you clicked something you should not have, tell IT immediately. It is always better to report than to wait.
